text:
Rhea (PM): Quick thread to capture scope for a compact enterprise compliance deliverable: customers want a bundle (audit logs + metadata + signed manifest) and a retention policy they can buy. Need decisions today on defaults and gating.
Noah (Eng): Agreed. Minimal viable export: JSONL shards + manifest.json + GZIP tarball. Include per-file sha256 and overall manifest signature.
Priya (Security): Signed manifest required. Use HSM-backed ECDSA for signing. Also include a manifest version field.
Evan (Legal): Customers ask for a clause that allows escrow only with explicit opt-in. We also need language about who can request an export and notification windows.
Carmen (CS): Pilots want a Console toggle "legal hold" that stops TTLs and shows export status. Need a progress indicator and access control.
Liam (Compliance): For SOC2 evidence, auditors want who toggled holds and why; those records must be immutable and retained.
Noah (Eng): Implementation: retention_tier on each write (short|medium|long), metadata indexed, blobs go to cold after TTL. Export job: collect by tenant+range, stream JSONL shards, compute checksums, produce manifest, sign, package.
Priya (Security): BYOK implications: two modes: store encrypted with customer KMS (we never have plaintext) or escrow-wrapped key for long-term exports with customer consent. No automatic escrow.
Evan (Legal): Draft consent snippet: "Customer permits Redwood to retain a wrapped copy of the encryption key solely for the purposes of evidence export; revocation requires 30 days' notice and may limit historical exportability."
Rhea (PM): Defaults proposal: audit_trail=2y, request_metadata=1y, payloads=90d. Enterprise customers can request long (7y) with paid addon. Thoughts?
Noah (Eng): Works for v1. Limit per-route overrides to enterprise plans to cut complexity.
Carmen (CS): We'll need pricing doc and a PCI/PHI pilot for healthcare/fintech. I can recruit two early testers.
Liam (Compliance): Add operational SLOs: export verification time per GB, manifest signature verification under 2s, export success rate 99.9% monthly.
Priya (Security): Threat model: protect signing keys with HSM, ensure manifest timestamps are accurate, and include a notarization token if customers want stronger non-repudiation.
Evan (Legal): Also add subpoena handling: notify customer unless legally barred, and maintain an audit trail of requests. Drafting playbook.
Noah (Eng): Tech risks: index growth and cold-restore cost. Mitigation: index only metadata; cold content on paid tier.
Rhea (PM): Launch criteria draft: 1) manifest spec published; 2) Console legal-hold toggle + export preview; 3) BYOK opt-in escrow flow documented; 4) 2 pilot exports successful; 5) runbook and SLOs published.
Priya (Security): Security gating: HSM signing in place, threat model reviewed, opt-in recorded.
Evan (Legal): Legal gating: consent text approved and subcontractor/escrow terms reviewed.
Carmen (CS): Pilot gating: fintech + healthcare complete E2E export and verify chain-of-custody artifacts.
Noah (Eng): Timeline: RFC + manifest spec this week, alpha export (audit logs only) in 6 weeks, pilot with BYOK escrow in 14 weeks, GA in ~20 weeks.
Rhea (PM): Action items: Noah - export schema + stub RFC (due EOW). Priya - HSM/signing design + threat model (due EOW). Evan - consent + subpoena playbook (due EOW). Carmen - pilot list (due +7d). Liam - SOC2 checklist (due +7d).
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled for 1w: Follow-up on compliance export deliverable.
